newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends mostly up on nearbys.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends mostly up on nearbys.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures were tightly mixed by the close on Monday with nearby positions inching higher in thin volume.
August ended at $326 per tonne, unchanged from the previous close, and well above its initial support at $325.
After a flurry of fund-inspired buying at the start of last week, which pushed the front-month position to a high of $330.80, the position has steadily retraced as profits were taken.
The $330.80 high was the culmination of a rally started in mid-January when August hit a low of $295.00.
But with the lack of movement in New York, the London market failed to kick into life, traders said.
"I think people are still a little surprised the market is holding so well in New York but London is going to be well supported down to $320," one said.
Second-month contract October firmed 40 cents at $316.70.
On the fundamental front, results were still awaited in Bangladesh's tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of white sugar for shipment by August 8. Bidding took place on June 8.
